2.50.21
Matrix.PageBreakAtStart
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.PageBreakAtStart element specifies whether a renderer inserts a page break at the start
of this Matrix. This element is optional. The value of Matrix.PageBreakAtStart MUST be a Boolean
([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.2). If this element is not specified, its value is interpreted as false.
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.PageBreakAtStart element.
Parent elements
Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.PageBreakAtStart element.
 <xsd:element name="PageBreakAtStart" type="xsd:boolean" minOccurs="0" />
